⌨CONTROLS & MOVEMENT TIPS
WASD move
SHIFT sprint
SPACE jump (hold = bhop)
C slide / crouch
LMB fire
RMB aim / scope
G grenade
1 2 / wheel weapons
Q last weapon
R reload
TAB scores
M music · ESC pause
F3 performance stats
ENTER chat · U team chat · MOUSE 3 ping
Every key can be rebound in Settings → KEYBINDS
CONTROLLER supported: L stick move (push fully to sprint) · R stick look · RT fire · LT aim · A jump · B slide · X reload · Y swap · LB grenade · RB last weapon · Start pause

Slide-hop: sprint, hold C to slide, tap SPACE. Keep holding C and tap SPACE each landing to chain boosts.

Slide crits: shots fired while sliding deal +25% damage.

Rocket jump: look down, jump + fire.

Bhop / air-strafe: in the air hold A or D and turn the mouse the same way to gain speed; hold SPACE to hop on landing with no friction.

Wall-run: jump at a tall wall at an angle while holding W. Press SPACE to wall-jump off.
